say:3:1421146001:1.text: Nice to meet you, Zanie. We're here to gather some inspiration for a poem.
say:3:1421146001:1.source_cn: 祖娅女士你好，我们是来采风的。

say:4:1421146002:1.text: Inspiration? I'm afraid all you'll end up with here is volcanic ash!
say:4:1421146002:1.source_cn: 采风？你们在这里采到的都是火山灰吧！

choice_prompt:5:1421146002.text: Inspiration? I'm afraid all you'll end up with here is volcanic ash!
choice_prompt:5:1421146002.source_cn: 采风？你们在这里采到的都是火山灰吧！

say:6:1421146003:1.text: You're writing a poem for Indris! I'm all for it! What can I do to help?
say:6:1421146003:1.source_cn: 噢噢，给因度厄那小子写诗？我支持！有什么我能做的吗？

say:7:1421146004:1.text: We've collected different views on Captain Indris at various stages of his life...
say:7:1421146004:1.source_cn: 是这样的，我们已经收集了不同人眼中不同时期的因度厄大人...

say:8:1421146005:1.text: I'm now working on the adventure that made him a legend. Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style> thought it'd be best to hear it from you.
say:8:1421146005:1.source_cn: 但最终他创造传奇的冒险，<style=stress><...
say:8:1421146005:1.male: I'm now working on the adventure that made him a legend. Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style> thought it'd be best to hear it from you.
say:8:1421146005:1.female: I'm now working on the adventure that made him a legend. Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style> thought it'd be best to hear it from you.

say:9:1421146006:1.text: You're making me sound too important. In fact, <style="stress"><player_name></style> was there with Indris every step of the way.
say:9:1421146006:1.male: You're making me sound too important. In fact, <style="stress"><player_name></style> was there with Indris every step of the way.
say:9:1421146006:1.female: You're making me sound too important. In fact, <style="stress"><player_name></style> was there with Indris every step of the way.

say:10:1421146007:1.text: Still, I'm more than happy to share my experience...
say:10:1421146007:1.source_cn: 不过我也不客气了，就给你们讲讲我所看到的故事吧——

narration:11:1421146008:0.text: Zanie gives Otivia a detailed account of how she met Indris, their friendship with Feli, the grief of losing a friend, and the difficulty of facing harsh reality...
narration:11:1421146008:0.source_cn: 祖娅为欧蒂薇娓娓道来了与因度厄的相遇，与斐利尔的友情，...

narration:12:1421146009:0.text: Step by step, Indris unraveled the truth and rediscovered himself amidst the painful and grim realities. He drew Helthor's bow, unleashed the dragon, and defeated the Queen...
narration:12:1421146009:0.source_cn: 一步步揭穿真相，又在痛苦而肮脏的真相中找回自我，拉开赫...

say:13:1421146010:1.text: Such... an awe-inspiring story... *Sob* It's like something straight out of a legendary tale!
say:13:1421146010:1.source_cn: 太……太感人了……呜呜，而且就像真正的英雄史诗一样……

say:14:1421146011:1.text: Indris pushed through the pain to uncover the truth. Without losing himself, he brought light to Sal'thorin.
say:14:1421146011:1.source_cn: 是啊，在痛苦中迈出通往真实的脚步，绝不放弃自我，为萨洛...

say:15:1421146012:1.text: Thanks, Zanie. You made me feel like I was part of the adventure too.
say:15:1421146012:1.source_cn: 谢谢您，托您的福，连我都仿佛经历了一段这样精彩的故事。

say:16:1421146013:1.text: Indris totally deserves all the glory for his hard work.
say:16:1421146013:1.source_cn: 也是因度厄那小子自己够坚定，够争气，才能做出这样的成果啊。

say:17:1421146014:1.text: He accomplished something that the dwarves had struggled for years to achieve. Though <style="stress"><player_name></style>'s guidance played a role, he couldn't have done it without his own effort.
say:17:1421146014:1.source_cn: 上头的那些矮人们奋斗了那么久都没做到的事，他一个人就做...
say:17:1421146014:1.male: He accomplished something that the dwarves had struggled for years to achieve. Though <style="stress"><player_name></style>'s guidance played a role, he couldn't have done it without his own effort.
say:17:1421146014:1.female: He accomplished something that the dwarves had struggled for years to achieve. Though <style="stress"><player_name></style>'s guidance played a role, he couldn't have done it without his own effort.

say:18:1421146015:1.text: Zanie, I've jotted down everything you shared. There's one more favor I'd like to ask of you.
say:18:1421146015:1.source_cn: 祖娅女士，您所说的故事我都已经记下了，我还有一个不情之请。

say:19:1421146016:1.text: Can I wander around here a bit and check out any remnants of the dragon?
say:19:1421146016:1.source_cn: 我想在这里逛一逛，看看龙留下的遗迹！

say:20:1421146017:1.text: Certainly. There's a boat you can use here!
say:20:1421146017:1.source_cn: 没问题，正好这边还有能用的船！

say:21:1421146018:1.text: The dragon's no longer here, so I'm afraid there's not much to see...
say:21:1421146018:1.source_cn: 不过，龙已经不在了，现在并没什么可看的……

say:22:1421146019:1.text: That's not an issue! I just want to get a taste of the adventure you all had back then!
say:22:1421146019:1.source_cn: 嗯，没关系！我只是想体验一下当时你们冒险的过程！

choice:5:0:1.text: So, Zanie, this is what happened...
choice:5:0:1.male: So, Zanie, this is what happened...
choice:5:0:1.female: So, Zanie, this is what happened...
